history.summary: A freehold 2BR (Smart Suites, D14) just 260m from Aljunied MRT at $1.25M / $1,416 psf — about 10% below the $1,567 URA median, an efficient 883 sqft layout in the deep sub-$1.3M buyer band. The standout is doorstep MRT and a genuine PSF discount; the catch is a weak 1.35% face-value CAGR on a thin 17-txn series.
history.rating_rationale: Doorstep MRT (260m to Aljunied EW9), freehold tenure, an efficient 883 sqft 2BR (no size bloat), and a real ~10% discount to the $1,567 URA median at a liquid $1.25M quantum — this is a clean, broadly saleable, rentable package. The 1.35% appreciation is low but it is resale-only and from only 17 txns, so it understates likely performance for a doorstep-MRT freehold in gentrifying Geylang/Aljunied. The strong frontier position (score 774) and below-median entry give margin of safety.

history.summary: A real but thinly-evidenced discount on a 3BR penthouse in a tiny 72-unit Geylang-fringe freehold project — cheap, but illiquid and data-quirky, so Neutral.
history.rating_rationale: Asking $1.5M / $1,290 psf for the 1,163 sqft unit is below the project's 12mo transacted range of $1,529-$1,586 psf (avg ~$1,558), so the -30.4% age-adj and -13.6% vs cohort point to a genuine discount — but the evidence is thin: psf_cohort_txns=0, appreciation_txns=17, the project has only 72 units, and the unit is a 3BR penthouse (1,163 sqft is tight for 3BR, hence the 'very_low_psf' flag context). Per v3.4 I down-weight a big negative premium built on so few comparables and cut confidence. D14 Sims Ave is Geylang-fringe — usable RCR location but with red-light-proximity sentiment drag on resale and tenant mix. Freehold is not a forward edge per v3.4. Real value is offset by illiquidity, thin data, and location stigma — Neutral, low confidence.
red_flags: psf_cohort_txns=0 and only 17 appreciation txns — discount is thinly evidenced
1,163 sqft 3BR penthouse — tight layout, niche resale
D14 Sims Ave — Geylang red-light proximity sentiment/tenant drag
catalysts: Freehold tenure (durability, but not a forward edge per v3.4)
